objective: Decide whether fictional Vale Components can support a capacity-based fundraising case.

sources.title: Fundraising deck
sources.extract: Vale Components Ltd markets a 90% first-pass yield and says the test proves repeatable commercial production.

sources.title: Scoped QA run
sources.extract: The supervised single-shift trial processed 100 units. 81 passed on first inspection. Nine additional units passed after rework. Ten units were scrapped. No multiple-shift or commercial-volume records were reviewed.

sources.title: Funding file index
sources.extract: No dated equipment quote, cash ledger or working-capital schedule. A customer expression of interest is conditional on multi-shift acceptance and binds no purchaser.

questions.question: Give first-pass yield as a percentage number.
Give final acceptance yield after rework as a percentage number.
Classify the 90% first-pass claim as supported, contradicted, different_basis, or unknown.
Classify the expression of interest as binding or conditional.
Give a supported required raise in USD or null.

priority_options.THROUGHPUT: Representative multi-shift production, downtime and quality logs.
priority_options.CASH_CAPEX: Reconciled cash, equipment quotes and working capital.
